    Nautilus

    Work in Progress

    Nautilus replaces linear, chat-style AI with a node-based knowledge interface built on neural networking. Every prompt becomes a concept Card, and the system vectorises content through bi-encoders for fast retrieval and re-ranks the most relevant links with a cross-encoder. The result is a graph that learns the semantic structure between your ideas across multiple databases instead of treating them as isolated messages. Still very much a work in progress, this round is a content overhaul.

    Live DemoGitHub

    Key Features

    Infinite Canvas

    Pan, zoom, and freehand drawing on an infinite zoomable canvas with smooth interactions.

    AI-Generated Cards

    Topic cards, concept cards, and flowcharts generated from a simple prompt using AI.

    Multiple Node Types

    Content cards, topic nodes, and flowchart shapes with full markdown rendering support.

    Smart Labeled Edges

    Automatic layout with labeled connections between nodes using the Dagre algorithm.

    AI Chain Explanations

    Select connected nodes and get AI-generated explanations for the entire chain of concepts.

    Auto-save & Undo/Redo

    Session management with persistent auto-save, full undo/redo history, and state recovery.

    Tech Stack

    Frontend

    React • TypeScript • Vite • Tailwind CSS • shadcn/ui

    Canvas

    React Flow (@xyflow/react) • Dagre

    Animation

    Framer Motion

    Backend

    Supabase Edge Functions (Deno)

    Database

    Supabase PostgreSQL

    State & Routing

    React Query • React Router
